keywords: ethrex 两个 frame 测试网
summary: frame 交易成为 Hegotá 头条后，ethrex 表示其实现已运行两个公共测试网；Derek Chiang 用通俗语言解释 EIP-8288，称若能上线将是以太坊最具突破性的升级之一。EIP-8250 合并修正，保留 EIP-8141 交易载荷中嵌套的 `fees` 列表。Safe 生态的隐私方案 Bermuda 上线，隐私池资金可由 Safe 控制。

summary_en: After frame transactions became the Hegotá headliner, ethrex said its implementation now runs two public testnets; Derek Chiang explained EIP-8288 in plain words, calling it one of the most groundbreaking possible updates to Ethereum. EIP-8250 merged a fix keeping EIP-8141's nested `fees` list in the transaction payload. Bermuda, a privacy solution for the Safe ecosystem, launched with privacy pool funds controlled by a Safe.
